notes.title: A 3D environment is currently in development!
notes.content: [h2][b]Important Announcement:[/b][/h2][p]Here’s a very important update regarding the future of [i]From Zero to Slime Hero[/i], so please read until the end — thank you![/p][p][/p][p]I’m excited to announce that I am currently developing a [b]3D version[/b] of the game, which will permanently replace the 2D version! This means that when you launch the game, you’ll immediately enter the new 3D environment instead of the old 2D one.[/p][p][/p][p]I don’t yet have a final answer on whether the 2D version will remain accessible... BUT in the meantime, you’ll be able to play it through an [b]"Arcade Machine"[/b] located in the basement of your [b]"Friend’s"[/b] house [i](the one with the green hoodie and blue eyes)[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]I don’t have a release date in mind yet, but I can assure you that I’m working tirelessly on this update.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Why the change?[/b][/h3][p]There are two main reasons why I decided to move the game from 2D to 3D:[/p][olist][*][p]2D is far too complex, especially when it comes to sprites [i](characters, items, decorations, backgrounds, etc.)[/i] and even more so for animations, since everything must be drawn frame by frame — it’s a real headache.[/p][/*][*][p]3D is infinitely easier to work with, especially if you already have skills in 3D modeling and animation [i](which I do now)[/i].[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]I originally started this project in 2D because that was the level of programming knowledge I had back then—it was the only thing I knew how to do. But after countless hours of learning and practice, I’ve finally gained the skills needed to develop a game in 3D using the engine I work with.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Here are some sneak peeks:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][i]Sneak Peeks of some characters:[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45443467/96bbf37f7114f2fca8f38f01755cb09bbb0218d5.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45443467/541a578a593239db59e46977898f26a632336564.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][i]An image of some items (both new and returning) that you’ll be able to collect:[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45443467/9e97cf345ae187400c3654d06d4220bcbf160b1a.png"][/img][b]Items now have rarities![/b] Ranging from [b]Common[/b] to [b]Godly[/b]![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That’s all for this announcement — I hope you enjoyed it![/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Again, I don’t know the exact release date yet. It’s getting closer, but it’s still unknown.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for your patience and for reading this far—cheers![/p][p][i](And I’ll be adding a little secret in the game that only those who read the next announcement all the way to the end will discover ;D)[/i][/p]

notes.title: Official Release
notes.content:
[u][b]What's new:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] New Languages [i](French & Portuguese)[/i]
[*] Able to change the Game's Language in the Settings
[*] Gems Added
[*] Crafting System
[*] Dash Ability
[*] Double Jump Ability Added
[*] Able to skip the Tutorial Quests
[*] Able to Cancel a Quest
[*] Settings Added [i](in game)[/i]
[*] Able to stop the moving bg in the Settings [i](better perform.)[/i]
[*] New elements in the Main Menu
[*] New UI in the Arcade Machine
[*] New Mini Game in the Arcade Machine [i](S-Lava Jumper)[/i]
[/list]

[u][b]Issues fixed:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Save & Load system wasn't Saving or Loading correctly
[/list]
